fg_a.label: Monomer A Groups
fg_a.toolTip: Which groups of the current molecule react. Auto picks the group that pairs with monomer B.

use_selection.label: Use Selected Atoms Only
use_selection.toolTip: React only the functional groups that touch the current selection, instead of every group in the molecule.

monomer_b.label: Monomer B
monomer_b.toolTip: Second monomer. Leave as (none) for a homopolymer.

fg_b.label: Monomer B Groups
fg_b.toolTip: Only used with 'Custom SMILES…'; library entries carry their own group.

b_smiles.label: Partner SMILES
b_smiles.toolTip: Used only when the partner is 'Custom SMILES…'.

repeating_unit.label: Repeating Unit
repeating_unit.toolTip: A is the current molecule, B is monomer B. 'AB' alternates; 'A' is a homopolymer. The chain is then closed into a ring.

num_repeats.label: Number of Repeats
num_repeats.toolTip: How many times the repeating unit is repeated.

cleanup.label: Clean Up Geometry
cleanup.toolTip: Run stk's MCHammer to remove the worst of the idealised vertex geometry. This is not a force field — optimize the result afterwards.
